newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 62.2 bln dmk repos, adds funds.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 62.2 bln dmk repos, adds funds.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Tuesday it had awarded 62.2 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed rate of three percent.

The central bank accepted 25.7 percent of the bids for 15-day funds. A repo pact for 60.6 billion marks at a fixed three percent rate expires today, so a net 1.6 billion marks has been added to the market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 242.1 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. The repo allocation was one day earlier than usual because of a German public holiday on Thursday.
